targets.expr:
sum_over_time((
  (
    sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity=~"sensor.fronius_mppt_module_0_lifetime_energy|sensor.fronius_mppt_module_1_lifetime_energy"})[5m]))
    - sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.smart_meter_ts_65a_3_real_energy_produced"})[5m]))
    + sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.fronius_mppt_module_3_lifetime_energy"})[5m]))
    - sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.fronius_mppt_module_2_lifetime_energy"})[5m]))
  ) / 1000
  * on() group_left
  keep_last_value(sum(hass_sensor_monetary_kr_per_kwh{entity="sensor.stromligning_current_price_vat"}))
)[$__range:5m])
+ sum_over_time((
  sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.smart_meter_ts_65a_3_real_energy_produced"})[5m])) / 1000
  * on() group_left
  keep_last_value(sum(hass_sensor_monetary_kr_per_kwh{entity="sensor.stromligning_spotprice_ex_vat"}))
)[$__range:5m])

(
  sum_over_time((

      - sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.smart_meter_ts_65a_3_real_energy_produced"})[5m]))

      - sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.fronius_mppt_module_2_lifetime_energy"})[5m]))
    ) / 1000
    * on() group_left
    keep_last_value(sum(hass_sensor_monetary_kr_per_kwh{entity="sensor.stromligning_current_price_vat"}))
  )[$__range:5m])
  + sum_over_time((
    sum(increase(interpolate(hass_sensor_energy_wh{entity="sensor.smart_meter_ts_65a_3_real_energy_produced"})[5m])) / 1000
    * on() group_left
    keep_last_value(sum(hass_sensor_monetary_kr_per_kwh{entity="sensor.stromligning_spotprice_ex_vat"}))
  )[$__range:5m])
) / ($__range_s / 86400) * 365 / $solar_installation_cost * 100
